groups.title: General
groups.desc: Core helpers: testing for missing values and changing types.

groups.title: Declaration and inputs
groups.desc: The indicator() line and every input.* setting.

groups.title: Indicators (ta)
groups.desc: Moving averages, oscillators, volatility and pattern helpers. Each call keeps its own running memory, so call them on every bar.

groups.title: Math
groups.desc: Numbers and arithmetic.

groups.title: Text (str)
groups.desc: Building and reading text.

groups.title: Colors
groups.desc: Named colors and ways to make your own.

groups.title: Arrays
groups.desc: Lists of values. Method style works too: prices.push(close).

groups.title: Maps
groups.desc: Lookup tables from a key to a value.

groups.title: Plots and chart colors
groups.desc: Everything that draws one value per bar. Call these at the top level of your script.

groups.title: Labels
groups.desc: Text notes at a price and bar.

groups.title: Lines
groups.desc: Line segments between two points.

groups.title: Boxes
groups.desc: Rectangles between two corners.

groups.title: Tables
groups.desc: A grid of text pinned to a corner of the pane.

groups.title: Alerts
groups.desc: Rules and messages that notify you.

groups.title: Other symbols and timeframes
groups.desc: Read values from another timeframe or symbol. Never looks ahead.

groups.title: Order book (book)
groups.desc: Level 2 data: resting orders. Follows your plan like the charts do. Where there is no depth feed you get na and one notice.
groups.plan: Pro data. Returns na (plus one notice) when your plan does not include it.

groups.title: Order flow (flow)
groups.desc: Trades, delta, big trades, footprint and value area, per bar.
groups.plan: Pro data. Returns na (plus one notice) when your plan does not include it.

groups.title: GEX levels (gex)
groups.desc: Option gamma levels from GEX+. Updated a few minutes at a time, not an instant feed.
groups.plan: GEX+ data. Returns na (plus one notice) when your plan does not include it.

groups.title: ZoroOptions (opt)
groups.desc: Gamma nodes, ranges, IV rank and more. Updated a few minutes at a time, not an instant feed.
groups.plan: Pro data. Returns na (plus one notice) when your plan does not include it.

groups.title: Built-in variables
groups.desc: Values that exist in every script, such as close, bar_index and barstate.islast.

functions.name: ta.sma
functions.desc: Simple moving average of the last length values. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.ema
functions.desc: Exponential moving average (alpha 2/(length+1), starts from an SMA). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.rma
functions.desc: Wilder's moving average (alpha 1/length, starts from an SMA). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.wma
functions.desc: Linearly weighted moving average. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.vwma
functions.desc: Volume-weighted moving average. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.hma
functions.desc: Hull moving average. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.alma
functions.desc: Arnaud Legoux moving average. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.swma
functions.desc: Symmetric 4-bar weighted moving average. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.rsi
functions.desc: Relative strength index, 0 to 100. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.macd
functions.desc: MACD line, signal line and histogram. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.stoch
functions.desc: Stochastic: where source sits in the high-low range of length bars, 0 to 100. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.atr
functions.desc: Average true range (RMA of the true range). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.tr
functions.desc: True range of this bar. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.bb
functions.desc: Bollinger Bands: middle, upper, lower. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.bbw
functions.desc: Bollinger Band width as a percent of the middle band. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.kc
functions.desc: Keltner Channels: middle (EMA), upper, lower. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.kcw
functions.desc: Keltner Channel width. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.cci
functions.desc: Commodity channel index. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.mfi
functions.desc: Money flow index, 0 to 100. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.vwap
functions.desc: Volume-weighted average price, restarting each day ("D"), week ("W") or month ("M"). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.cum
functions.desc: Running total of source since the first bar. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.change
functions.desc: source minus its value length bars ago (for bool: true if it changed). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.mom
functions.desc: Momentum: source minus source length bars ago. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.roc
functions.desc: Rate of change in percent. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.crossover
functions.desc: True on the bar where a crosses above b. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.crossunder
functions.desc: True on the bar where a crosses below b. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.cross
functions.desc: True on the bar where a and b cross either way. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.highest
functions.desc: Highest value of the last length bars. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.lowest
functions.desc: Lowest value of the last length bars. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.highestbars
functions.desc: Offset (0 or negative) to the highest bar of the last length bars. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.lowestbars
functions.desc: Offset (0 or negative) to the lowest bar of the last length bars. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.pivothigh
functions.desc: Pivot high price, known rightbars bars after the pivot (na otherwise). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.pivotlow
functions.desc: Pivot low price, known rightbars bars after the pivot (na otherwise). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.valuewhen
functions.desc: Value of source on the bar where condition was true (occurrence 0 = most recent). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.barssince
functions.desc: Bars since condition was last true (na if never). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.stdev
functions.desc: Standard deviation. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.variance
functions.desc: Variance. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.dev
functions.desc: Mean absolute deviation from the SMA. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.correlation
functions.desc: Correlation coefficient, -1 to 1. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.linreg
functions.desc: Linear regression value (least squares line) at offset bars back. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.supertrend
functions.desc: SuperTrend line and direction (-1 up trend, 1 down trend). Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.percentrank
functions.desc: Percent of the previous length values that are at or below the current one. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.median
functions.desc: Median of the last length values. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.range
functions.desc: Highest minus lowest of the last length values. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.rising
functions.desc: True if source rose on each of the last length bars. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.falling
functions.desc: True if source fell on each of the last length bars. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.dmi
functions.desc: Directional movement: +DI, -DI and ADX. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.wpr
functions.desc: Williams %R, -100 to 0. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.cmo
functions.desc: Chande momentum oscillator. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.tsi
functions.desc: True strength index, -1 to 1. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.sar
functions.desc: Parabolic SAR. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.

functions.name: ta.mode
functions.desc: Most frequent value of the last length values. Call on every bar: it keeps its own running memory.
